programme.title: Chakkiligintha
programme.desc: Krishna and Shailu find themselves caught between love, friendship and misunderstandings, leading to a romantic journey filled with laughter and emotions.

programme.title: Mad - Mad About Dance
programme.desc: Determined to chase his dreams, a passionate dancer overcomes obstacles, rivalry and self-doubt while striving to make a mark in the world of dance.

programme.title: Businessman 2
programme.desc: Karthik comes to India when one of his companies gets into legal trouble. He meets Divya and tries to convince her to withdraw the case.

programme.title: Loafer-The Hero
programme.desc: Raja believes that his mother is dead, and becomes a thief. He falls in love with Mouni. Raja is shocked when he meets Mouni's aunt.

programme.title: Khiladi
programme.desc: Priya, a criminologist, makes a mistake, and a murder suspect escapes. She and Arjun work together to solve the mystery. They uncover murder and money laundering related to the case.

programme.title: Koi Mil Gaya
programme.desc: An autistic young man's life changes dramatically after meeting an alien, sparking unexpected friendship, self-discovery, and new perspectives on communication, identity, and belonging.

programme.title: Radhe Shyam
programme.desc: In 1970s Europe, famous palmist Vikramaditya falls for doctor Prerana. Their love is tested by his belief in fate and the looming shadow of a terminal illness threatening their future.

programme.title: Aparichit - The Stranger
programme.desc: Ramanujam, a lawyer with multiple personality disorder, becomes a vigilante by night, using the teachings of the Garuda Purana to punish and expose criminals and antisocial elements.

programme.title: Deva
programme.desc: Dev Ambre, a ruthless cop, loses his memory after solving a murder. He must reinvestigate, hidden from everyone except DCP Farhan Khan during dangerous investigations.

programme.title: Ragini MMS 2
programme.desc: Ragini's viral video sparks buzz. A sleazy filmmaker sets his next horror movie in the same haunted house-only to stir the evil that still lurks in its shadows.

programme.title: Khamoshi
programme.desc: In a haunted mansion, a mute girl confronts sinister spirits and hidden truths, fighting against fear and darkness to uncover the chilling secret of her past.

programme.title: The Xpose
programme.desc: Rival actresses Zara and Chandni; Zara is found dead; Ravi defends Chandni.

programme.title: Shiva The Super Hero 3
programme.desc: Three friends invest in a beach resort that turns haunted. They enlist Rudra, a renowned mentalist, to uncover the paranormal mystery and restore peace.

programme.title: Jigarwala No 1
programme.desc: After Ranjeet is murdered by cruel landlord Dhurjan Singh, his brother Amar rises against oppression and faces a dangerous cycle of revenge and justice.

programme.title: Hero No.1
programme.desc: Timid Rajesh Malhotra Escapes His Tyrant Father And Meets Meena In A Foreign Land. The Two Lovers Decide To Marry, But When Meena'S Parents Object, Rajesh Decides To Win Them Over In The Quirkiest Way.

programme.title: Maaveran
programme.desc: Following a severe accident, a timid cartoonist starts hearing the inner voice of his superhero creation, empowering him to finally stand up against a ruthless syndicate.

programme.title: Makkhi
programme.desc: Sudeep, obsessed with Bindu, kills her lover Jani, who is reborn as a fly. Jani and Bindu team up to exact revenge on Sudeep in creative ways.

programme.title: Karan Arjun
programme.desc: Durga's sons Karan and Arjun seek revenge for their father's death but are killed by their uncle. Reincarnated years later, they return to fulfill their quest for justice and vengeance.

programme.title: Sardaar Gabbar Singh
programme.desc: The residents of Rattanpur are forced to face the wrath of Bhairav Singh, who unceremoniously usurps their land. They find respite when Gabbar Singh, a brave cop, takes on their oppressor.

programme.title: Tigers : Can A Salesman Be A Hero
programme.desc: Ayan, pharmaceutical salesman, opposes company over deadly baby formula.

programme.title: Welcome 2 Karachi
programme.desc: Two friends are kidnapped by the Taliban during a boat trip and end up in Karachi without their passports. Realizing the gravity of their situation, they desperately seek ways to escape.

programme.title: Detective Shivaji
programme.desc: Shivaji, a policeman, sets out to investigate a high-profile murder of a minister's son. However, while pursuing the leads, he must also deal with his own wife's death.

programme.title: Commando 2
programme.desc: A four-member team heads to Malaysia to retrieve money launderer Vicky Chaddha. The mission spirals into danger when one team member is critically injured, jeopardising everything.

programme.title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
programme.desc: Bhaijaan avoids marriage to keep peace with his brothers. But when they secretly plan to get him to fall in love, everything begins to change.

programme.title: Baaghi 4
programme.desc: Following A Failed Suicide Attempt, A Man Struggles With Reality And Descends Into Turmoil. His Family Faces Uncertainty While A Concealed Truth Lures Him Into A Complex Maze Of Obsession And Love.

programme.title: Aadhi Sabdham
programme.desc: A Paranormal Investigator Is Employed By A University To Look Into A Series Of Mysterious Deaths That Some Are Attributing To Supernatural Causes.

programme.title: Simmba
programme.desc: Simmba, a police officer, works for Durva, a smuggler. His life takes a turn when he decides to avenge a woman who was assaulted by Durva's brothers.

programme.title: Ravanasura
programme.desc: Ravindra, an inept junior lawyer at a law firm, agrees to help a business magnate clear her father's name of murder. However, when bodies start piling up, Ravindra begins to show his true colours.

programme.title: Dil Dhadakne Do
programme.desc: On a cruise to celebrate their parents' anniversary, a brother and sister deal with the impact of family considerations on their romantic lives.

programme.title: Thalayanamanthram

programme.title: Simhasanam
programme.desc: Madhava Menon, a respected village chief, faces trouble when a rival clan creates chaos in his village. Soon, his son steps forward to restore peace and order.

programme.title: Athisayan
programme.desc: Devan is an orphan raised by Maya. She's abducted before she can expose a high-profile group of criminals.

programme.title: Videsi Nair Swadesi Nair

programme.title: Malayogam
programme.desc: Two friends buckle under the pressure of supporting their family and marrying off their sisters. Despite the endless struggle, they provide a better quality of life for their families.

programme.title: Koode

programme.title: Malayalimamanu Vanakkam

programme.title: Chamayam

programme.title: Sreeragam
programme.desc: Venkiteswaran, an expatriate, comes back to his village to live rest of his life with his family. However, he is forced to leave his love, Rugmini, and marry another woman.

programme.title: Onathumbikkoroonjal
programme.desc: Augustine and Gracy are happily married and have a daughter, Teena. Their life is shattered with the arrival of Dr. Vasanth. Who is he?

programme.title: Unnikrishnante Adyathe Christmas
programme.desc: Sophia has an argument with her parents over her marriage and leaves the house. Her parents seek the help of her close friend, Unnikrishnan, in getting her back in the house.

programme.desc: During Sudha and Prakash's anniversary celebration, relatives pose uncomfortable questions, challenging Nikhil's patience and composure.

programme.title: Stuck In The Middle
programme.desc: A disagreement between Anita and her parents results in a cold war, leaving Nikhil caught between his wife and in-laws.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Nikhil expresses his feelings of being an outsider within the family, prompting an open discussion aimed at resolving underlying issues.

programme.title: Welcome Home
programme.desc: A few months after moving to Mumbai, Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita are finally settled. The peace is interrupted by the arrival of Nikhil's parents, Kiran (Shishir Sharma) and Vandana (Renuka Shahane), for a short visit. Anita, ever the perfectionist, is anxious to be the "perfect daughter-in-law," but her efforts are met with a series of awkward and hilarious hurdles.

programme.title: Surprise, Surprise!
programme.desc: The episode picks up with the fallout of Nikhil’s father, Kiran (Shishir Sharma), going missing during his walk in the previous episode. While he eventually returns, the tension doesn't dissipate. The "surprise" of the title is twofold: the unexpected arrival of Nikhil’s sister, Shreya (Kriti Vij), and the unsettling realization that something is physically or mentally "off" with Kiran.

programme.title: Spilling The Beans
programme.desc: The entire family—Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh), Anita (Eisha Chopra), Kiran (Shishir Sharma), Vandana (Renuka Shahane), and Shreya (Kriti Vij)—piles into a car to attend a relative's 60th birthday celebration. What was meant to be a joyful getaway becomes a pressure cooker for the long-standing resentment between the siblings.

programme.title: Something's Missing
programme.desc: The title is a poignant double entendre: it refers to a missing set of rings at the family function, but more deeply, it refers to the "missing" pieces of Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) memory. The facade of a "normal family vacation" finally crumbles, forcing the Solankis to stop pretending.

programme.title: House Of Cards
programme.desc: The title "House of Cards" refers to the fragile "perfect family" image the Solankis have tried to maintain. After the emotional explosion regarding Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health and Shreya’s (Kriti Vij) marriage, the "house" has finally collapsed—but in its place, something more honest is being built.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: In the Season 2 finale, "Home," Anita and Nikhil prepare to move into their own place. The episode resolves the season's friction between Anita and her mother-in-law, replacing awkward formalities with genuine mutual respect. As they move out, the story concludes that "home" isn't about physical space, but the emotional bridge built between two different generations.

programme.title: Circle Of Life
programme.desc: The title "Circle of Life" refers to the poignant role reversal where the children now become the guardians of their parents, mirroring the care they once received.

programme.title: Not Kidding
programme.desc: The episode centers on a visit from Anita’s boisterous, unfiltered parents—Akshata (Deepika Amin) and Kiran Sharma (Shishir Sharma). The quiet, disciplined, and currently somber Solanki household is suddenly upended by the high-energy Sharmas. The primary conflict arises when the two sets of parents have a "polite clash" over how to care for the ailing Kiran Solanki and, more pivotally, the couple's future plans regarding children.

programme.title: Here We Go Again
programme.desc: With the house now fully "merged," Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) decide to throw a surprise anniversary party for the "Folks." While their intentions are pure, the episode explores how a "celebration" can quickly become a source of stress when dealing with a chronic illness and interfering relatives.

programme.title: Zor Se Bolo
programme.desc: The episode revolves around a chaotic Sunday at the Solanki household. The central plot involves Kiran Solanki (Shishir Sharma) needing a hearing aid, but it quickly spirals into a larger commentary on how the family members are "deaf" to each other's actual needs and desires.

programme.title: That's All Folks
programme.desc: The finale moves away from the day-to-day bickering and centers on a quiet realization: Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Eisha Chopra) have finally stopped "adjusting" and have started living. The episode focuses on the family accepting their "New Normal" while acknowledging that the road ahead with Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health will be challenging but shared.

programme.title: Truth Bombs
programme.desc: The episode begins with Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Esha Chopra) gathering the family for a "serious talk." After months of private deliberation, they drop the ultimate truth bomb: they have decided to adopt a child instead of pursuing a biological pregnancy.

programme.title: The Damaad Test
programme.desc: The episode centers on the Home Study, a critical step in the Indian adoption process where a government social worker visits the family to determine if they are fit to raise a child. However, the title "The Damaad Test" (The Son-in-law Test) refers to the parallel pressure Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) feels to prove he is a "good son" while also being a "good son-in-law" to Anita’s (Eisha Chopra) visiting parents.

programme.title: Ladkiwale Vs. Ladkewale
programme.desc: While Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) are stuck in the agonizing "waiting period" of the CARA process, the tension shifts to the two sets of parents. The episode highlights that even when everyone agrees on the goal (the grandchild), their different ways of expressing love and anxiety can lead to a hilarious yet deep-seated cultural clash.

programme.title: Are We Ready?
programme.desc: The wait is over: Anita and Nikhil are matched with a child. However, instead of the pure euphoria they expected, they are hit with a wave of intense anxiety. The title "Are We Ready?" reflects the internal crisis the couple faces as they realize their lives are about to change irrevocably—not in nine months, but in a matter of days.

programme.title: What The Future?
programme.desc: The finale begins with the arrival of the moment Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) have spent the entire season preparing for: bringing their adopted daughter home. The episode isn't just about the new arrival, but about how each family member adapts to their "What The Future" role.

programme.title: Bow-Bot Robot

programme.desc: Book with magnet set in a case

programme.title: Blue-Ribbon Bunny

programme.title: Meet Blondie And Berry
programme.desc: Meet Blondie, a pony with royal aspirations, and Berry, a food-loving bunny, as they form unexpected friendships with Rapunzel and Snow White in enchanting adventures.

programme.title: Meet Pumpkin And Bayou
programme.desc: An enchanting story introduces lovable characters in a whimsical land, bringing lessons of friendship, courage, and kindness through heartwarming adventures in magical settings.

programme.title: M is for Monster
programme.desc: Join all the monsters of Monsters, Inc. in this great alphabet book written by Mike himself!

programme.title: Incredibles 2
programme.desc: The Incredibles 2 movie, with fun and emotions, has a superhero family. In the latest chapter, Mr. and Mrs. Incredible, Violet, Dash, and Jack-Jack encounter a new nemesis who challenges their power.

programme.title: A New Mission
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: Pride Lands Patrol
programme.desc: Join the Lion Guard as they protect the Pride Lands, with fun animal facts from the Disney Junior Un-Bunga-livable shorts! Follow the word-for-word narration.

programme.title: Huey, Dewey, And Louie's Rainy Day Adventure
programme.desc: It may be raining outside, but that won't stop Huey, Dewey and Louie from having fun at Uncle Donald's house! The boys come up with some great ideas: painting, drinking hot cocoa, playing games, etc.

programme.title: Return Of The Roar
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Learn how the Lion Guard came to be in this beautifully illustrated picture book based on the upcoming Disney Junior movie event.

programme.title: Merida And The Missing Gem
programme.desc: Join the Disney reading. Merida chooses a beautiful brooch for her mother's birthday, but the pin goes missing, and she, with friends, has to search the castle grounds to find it.

programme.title: You'Ve Gotta Be Kitten Me
programme.desc: Mischievous kittens cause chaos and delight. Amid humor and playful troubles, love and joy emerge, showing how mischief brings unexpected happiness.

programme.title: Anna & Elsa: Olaf'S Perfect Summer Day
programme.desc: Summer is here in Arendelle, and Olaf is very happy! He loves summer days. This story follows Olaf as he enjoys his perfect day in the warm weather.

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him
programme.desc: Few characters have Aladdin's singing, dancing, and joke-telling Genie's unique, irresistible appeal. This delightful picture book is ideal for any Aladdin fan who imagined having a friend like Genie.

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
programme.desc: When Scat Cat's home in the junkyard disappears one day, Duchess, O'Malley and their kittens come up with a new place for their pal! See how this family helps their friend when he needs them most.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Princess stories, little ones will fall asleep dreaming of fairy-tale endings and happily ever afters.

programme.title: Belle And The Castle Puppy
programme.desc: Belle gets a puppy, making Ottoman jealous because he misses being a real dog. He runs into the woods, and Belle and the puppy must rescue him.

programme.title: Belle And The Perfect Pearl
programme.desc: When Belle finds the Beast's favourite book, she sees that the leather cover is worn out. Belle decides to look for the missing pearl and fix up the book for the Beast as a surprise!

programme.title: Belle's Friendship Invention
programme.desc: When Belle sees a crowd gathered around a blue ribbon-winning invention, she volunteers to help the inventor-a girl named Simone-demonstrate how her machine works.

programme.title: Something More
programme.desc: Illustrated throughout with fantastic film stills this book presents an overview of the people, places, and creatures to be found in the magical tale of Beauty and the Beast.

programme.title: I Am Baymax
programme.desc: This is a comedy-adventure about brilliant robotics prodigy Hiro Hamada, who finds himself in the grips of a criminal plot that threatens to destroy the fast-paced, high-tech city of San Fransokyo.

programme.title: Baymax's Journey
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow Baymax as he travels through San Fransokyo in this charming storybook featuring word for word narration.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: Hiro, a smart kid, lives in San Fransokyo. A crime threatens the city. With friends and Baymax, a robot, Hiro becomes a hero. They must save their home!

programme.title: Fight To The Finish
programme.desc: Someone stole Hiro's invention and is using it for evil! Hiro must join forces with his friends and a robot named Baymax to save San Fransokyo before it's too late!

programme.title: Cars
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen takes to the track in three tales of speed! Follow along with word-for-word narration in this level one World of Reading reader bind up featuring Cars, Racing Days, etc.

programme.title: Driving Buddies
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, gets lost and finds friends in a small town. He learns important life lessons. Get ready for an exciting adventure!

programme.title: Driving School
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Mater must teach hot rod racers the rules of Radiator Springs. This story features characters from Disney/Pixar's Cars, promising a fun-filled adventure for young readers.

programme.title: Racing Days
programme.desc: Doc and Chick Hicks hold 3 races to see whose racing school is best. While Doc's student racers follow the rules, Chick's student racers bend them.

programme.title: Racing For Good
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Jeff Gorvette love to race, but there is one thing they love more: helping others. In this action-packed storybook, Lightning and his friends race to raise money to help old cars.

programme.title: Rally To The Finish
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater travel to the Black Forest for a race. Lightning is excited to race through the forest, but Mater gets scared when an old car tells them that a monster lives there.

programme.title: Roadwork
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, wants to win the Piston Cup. He ends up in Radiator Springs. McQueen learns that friendship is important.

programme.title: Francesco's Rematch
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his racing rival Francesco Bernoulli challenge each other to a race in Monza, Italy-Francesco's hometown. Both Lightning and Francesco are confident they will win the race.

programme.title: Mater And The Ghost Light
programme.desc: Mater the tow truck loves pranking his friends. But after he hears a scary story, Mater loses all zest for pranking. Now, he just wants to hide!

programme.title: Mater The Greater
programme.desc: Mater the Greater is a brave stunt performer who does many dangerous things in front of crowds. He jumps cars, flies through fire, and rides planes. Now, can he do his biggest stunt?

programme.title: Mater's Junkyard Jamboree
programme.desc: Mater can't wait to show his friends in Radiator Springs the junkyard jukebox he built, but they are too busy rounding up tractors on the loose-and the tractors are causing trouble everywhere they go!

programme.title: Monster Truck Mater
programme.desc: To become a world-champion monster truck wrestler, Mater must go through the ranks as a professional. I-Screamer, Captain Collision, and The Rasta Carian won't give up easily.

programme.title: Neon Racers
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his international racing friends are in Japan for the next leg of the T-ROC-the Transcontinental Race of Champions. But this isn't a normal race.it's a neon race!

programme.title: Radiator Springs Road Trip
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen's friends travel to California to support him in a race. They discover a rival is plotting against him and rush to warn him.

programme.title: Rescue Squad Mater
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: The Best Present Ever
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: Thunder And Lightning
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, the hot-shot rookie race car, is on his way to the race of a lifetime to claim the coveted Piston Cup. But Lightning hits a bump in the road along his journey.

programme.title: Tractor Trouble
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater want to relax by tractor tipping. They accidentally release the tractors! Can they round them up in time? Read along to find out in this fun adventure!

programme.title: Unidentified Flying Mater
programme.desc: Mater decides to teach it all his favorite things to do on Earth. But when the UFO is kidnapped, Mater must go undercover to rescue his friend.

programme.title: Race Around The World
programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest.

programme.title: Secret Agent Mater
programme.desc: Mater is a spy car and he has been instructed to catch bad cars! Follow along with word-for-word narration to see what spy life is like for Mater and his friends.

programme.title: Super Spies
programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest in DisneyPixar Cars 2.

programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow along with word-for-word narration and meet Lightning McQueen, Cruz Ramirez, and the rest of the crew from Cars 3!

programme.desc: Join Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gane as they search for their favorite colors. Follow along with word-for-word narration and help them find all the colors in the rainbow!

programme.title: Mickey Saves Santa
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends are all ready for a Christmas Eve sleepover at the Clubhouse. They've written their lists and can't wait for Santa Claus to arrive. Santa won't be coming unless he gets some help!

programme.title: Mickey's Easter Hunt
programme.desc: The Clubhouse pals are throwing an Easter party and Pete's upset because he thinks he isn't invited. Pete decides to make a change in the Clubhouse, he makes it disappear-with the friends still inside!

programme.title: Mickey's Halloween Treat
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends want to go to the Tower, for the Halloween party but, they have to get there before the moon is full! Toodles and Mouseketools are what Mickey need to find on his way to the tower.

programme.title: Minnie's Rainbow
programme.desc: In this colorful tale, Minnie Mouse simply explains how these beautiful apparitions are formed. Follow the narration as Minnie and her Clubhouse pals begin to see a world of rainbows around them.

programme.title: Top O' The Clubhouse
programme.desc: It's Saint Patrick's Day. Mickey and the gang are ready to celebrate! But when Pete's shenanigans threaten to ruin their celebration, it will take some help from Toodles, to get the party back on track.

programme.title: Homesick
programme.desc: Being sick is no fun for anyone, but Funny's sneezes are extra funny! Every sneeze sends Mickey, Minnie, and the rest of the gang through the wrong Adventure Doors. Will Funny ever feel better?

programme.title: Donald'S Stinky Day
programme.desc: When Donald accidentally rescues a cute little skunk, the grateful little stinker refuses to leave his side!

programme.title: Mickey'S Perfecto Day
programme.desc: Mickey and the Roadster Racers head to Madrid, Spain for some racing and sightseeing fun. But when a baby bull begins to chase them around town, their perfecto vacation starts to crumble!

programme.title: Ski Trippin
programme.desc: The gang is teaching Daisy to ski when she accidentally ends up in the middle of aa big skiing race! Using the skills she's learned along the way, can she pull off a big win?

programme.title: Hocus Bow-Cus
programme.desc: Minnie is launching her new 'Bows are Magical' fashion line. He forgot his bow tie at home, he rushes off to find it. Millie and Melody rehearsed with Penguini, but will they remember all the tricks?

programme.title: Minnie's Pet Salon
programme.desc: Minnie and friends get ready to pamper their pets at Minnie's Pet Salon! It's a spa day like no other for Pluto, Figaro, Bella, Butch, and Mr. Pettibone!

programme.title: The Case Of The Missing Sparkle-izer
programme.desc: Who's been using Minnie's new Sparkle-izer? When Minnie needs it to decorate her customers' bows, the Super Sparkle-izer turns up missing! It's up to Millie and Melody to solve the mystifying mystery!

programme.title: Always In Fashion
programme.desc: Minnie Mouse is always in fashion! She and Daisy love making bows at Minnie's Bow-tique. All of their friends want Minnie to make them bows.

programme.title: Blooming Bows
programme.desc: Minnie's nieces are very upset! The paper petals on their costumes are falling apart. Now, it''s up to Minnie to redesign the girls' costumes. But can she do it in time for the school's Posy Pageant?

programme.title: Bow-Bot Robot
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy get some help from a bow-making robot in this retelling of an episode of Disney Junior's Minnie's Bow Toons.

programme.title: Easter Bonnet Parade
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! One day, a little puppy with nowhere to go arrived at the Main Street USA train station. Seeking for a place to call his own, follow along as the little pup explores the town.

programme.title: Trouble Times Two
programme.desc: Movie star Penelope Poodle has come to Minnie''s Bow-Tique to find something perfect to wear. But when Minnie''s mischievous twin nieces, Millie and Melody, come for a visit, it''s Trouble Times Two!

programme.title: Year Round Fun
programme.desc: Book with magnet set in a case

programme.title: Riches To Rags
programme.desc: A young boy is taken to work by his Papa and Grandpa in an old wooden boat. He discovers his family's unusual line of work and will decide whether to follow them or find his way.

programme.title: Blue-Ribbon Bunny
programme.desc: Sofia and her bunny Clover enter a pet contest. Other kids have fancy pets. Sofia must decide: enter with a fancy pet or stay loyal to her best friend, Clover.

programme.title: Clover Time
programme.desc: When Clover's warren floods, Sofia invites her to move in. They love sharing a room-at first. But Sofia soon learns that being roommates isn't always easy in this fun story!

programme.title: Just One Of The Princes
programme.desc: Sofia wants to try out for a spot on Royal Prep's Flying Derby team, but Amber, Prince Hugo, and her classmates tell Sofia that Flying Derby is not a 'princess thing.'

programme.title: The Missing Necklace
programme.desc: When the Amulet of Avalor goes missing, Sofia loses her ability to understand her friends. Longing to talk to her friends again, Sofia sets off to find it. Cedric is also after the missing amulet.

programme.title: Welcome To Royal Prep
programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun
programme.desc: Life in Enchancia is full of fun! Join Sofia as she explores all the fun things there are to do-from dancing to joining the flying derby team and even spending the day at the Village Faire.

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem
programme.desc: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up!

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: A Mother's Love
programme.desc: Follow Princess Merida and her mother Queen Elinor on an epic adventure set in the Highlands of Scotland. When a beastly curse is unleashed upon the kingdom, Merida must try and set things right.

programme.title: Big Bear, Little Bear
programme.desc: Enter the world of Brave and learn about opposites.

programme.title: Oh, Brother
programme.desc: Meet Merida, a fearless princess with three siblings who are in trouble. Read and listen to the story to learn what happens when they transform into bear cubs. Will Merida rescue them in time?

programme.title: Merida And The Missing Gem
programme.desc: Join the Disney reading. Merida chooses a beautiful brooch for her mother's birthday, but the pin goes missing, and she, with friends, has to search the castle grounds to find it.

programme.title: One Perfect Day
programme.desc: Despite being instructed to behave like a typical princess, Disney's Princess Merida desires to practice archery, explore the kingdom, and be herself for a day.

programme.title: Cinderella's Best Ever Creations
programme.desc: The story explores how Cinderella must work to create a collection of dresses in a time-crunch. She creates beautiful gowns for girls and solves problems by creating an extra dress in a time crunch.

programme.title: The Great Cat-tastrophe
programme.desc: Cinderella agrees to help Lady Dupont watch the cats, Cinderella finds a clever way for them to lend a hand on her chores. Follow along as Cinderella and the cats tidy up the house together.

programme.title: Kindness And Courage
programme.desc: Ella's stepfamily is jeaous of her beauty and grace and tries to stop her from going to the royal ball. Will Ella make it to the ball and get her happily ever after?

programme.title: Moana Finds The Way
programme.desc: Moana sets sail on a great adventure across the ocean. Follow along with the word for word narration.

programme.title: Beware Of The Kakamora
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! While on their important voyage, Moana and Maui encounter the dangerous Kakamora. Follow along with the word for word narration in this exciting adventure.

programme.title: Moana
programme.desc: Mater is tasked with capturing suspicious vehicles because he is a spy vehicle! See what a spy's life is like for Mater and his friends by following the narration word for word.

programme.title: Moana And The Ocean
programme.desc: An engaging story about Moana's unique relationship with the Ocean that playfully interacts with stylized artwork.

programme.title: Our Perfect Stormy Day
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! When a storm hits the island, Moana, Heihei, and Pua head to Gramma Tala's for story time. Follow along with word-for-word narration as they all enjoy the perfect stormy day!

programme.title: Where Monsters Live
programme.desc: Moana, daughter of chief Tui, embarks on a journey to return the heart of goddess Te Fitti from Maui, a demigod, after the plants and the fish on her island start dying due to a blight.

programme.title: The Guardian Of The Dragon Gem
programme.desc: In Kumandra, Raya, a brave warrior, seeks the last dragon. She gathers a team to restore light and unity to their world. It's a fantasy adventure.

programme.title: Paperman
programme.desc: George meets Meg during his commute and is smitten. He sees her again and tries creative ways to get her attention using only his imagination and papers. This is a heartwarming Disney story.

programme.title: Budderball'S First Fair
programme.desc: Budderball is most excited about the food at the town fair: cotton candy, popcorn, peanuts-it all sounds so delicious! When the hungry pup stumbles upon a pie-eating contest.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Mater
programme.desc: Mater and the Gas Caps, records a hit song, Mater becomes a rock legend. Then Lightning joins Mater's band for the rock concert of the century!

programme.title: Home Stinky Home
programme.desc: To save a cute little alien, Lilo and Stitch have to find him a new home. There's just one problem: the alien smells awful! Who will they find to take him in if he stinks up everyplace he goes?

programme.title: Hauntley Girls
programme.desc: Vampirina and her mom start a book club. The first book is magical and spells the humans. They work hard to break the spell. Will they succeed?

programme.title: A Day To Remember
programme.desc: Elena loves celebrating Dia de los Muertos-The Day of the Dead-in Avalor. It's a day of remembrance to honor and celebrate her ancestors.

programme.title: Take Your Pet To The Vet
programme.desc: Doc's hamster, Coleslaw, needs a checkup. But there's one problem . . . Coleslaw isn't a toy, so it's time to take this pet to the vet! .

programme.title: Meet Blondie And Berry
programme.desc: Meet Blondie, a pony with royal aspirations, and Berry, a food-loving bunny, as they form unexpected friendships with Rapunzel and Snow White in enchanting adventures.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Cinderella's classic talebrings the timeless story of Cinderella to life! She meets the prince of her dreams, her Fairy Godmother, and dances at the royal ball.

programme.title: Cloud Country
programme.desc: Sitting there, among the clouds, looking down and day dreaming is... a little cloudlet. Gale would like nothing more than to make one real cloud shape. But instead, she creates something different.

programme.title: Babysitter Bunga
programme.desc: Bunga becomes the unorthodox babysitter in the Pride Lands, teaching kids how to defend themselves. Follow the narration as they use his lessons to fight off the jackals!

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him
programme.desc: Few characters have Aladdin's singing, dancing, and joke-telling Genie's unique, irresistible appeal. This delightful picture book is ideal for any Aladdin fan who imagined having a friend like Genie.

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
programme.desc: When Scat Cat's home in the junkyard disappears one day, Duchess, O'Malley and their kittens come up with a new place for their pal! See how this family helps their friend when he needs them most.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Princess stories, little ones will fall asleep dreaming of fairy-tale endings and happily ever afters.

programme.title: Belle And The Castle Puppy
programme.desc: Belle gets a puppy, making Ottoman jealous because he misses being a real dog. He runs into the woods, and Belle and the puppy must rescue him.

programme.title: Belle And The Perfect Pearl
programme.desc: When Belle finds the Beast's favourite book, she sees that the leather cover is worn out. Belle decides to look for the missing pearl and fix up the book for the Beast as a surprise!

programme.title: Belle's Friendship Invention
programme.desc: When Belle sees a crowd gathered around a blue ribbon-winning invention, she volunteers to help the inventor-a girl named Simone-demonstrate how her machine works.

programme.title: Something More
programme.desc: Illustrated throughout with fantastic film stills this book presents an overview of the people, places, and creatures to be found in the magical tale of Beauty and the Beast.

programme.title: I Am Baymax
programme.desc: This is a comedy-adventure about brilliant robotics prodigy Hiro Hamada, who finds himself in the grips of a criminal plot that threatens to destroy the fast-paced, high-tech city of San Fransokyo.

programme.title: Baymax's Journey
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow Baymax as he travels through San Fransokyo in this charming storybook featuring word for word narration.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: Hiro, a smart kid, lives in San Fransokyo. A crime threatens the city. With friends and Baymax, a robot, Hiro becomes a hero. They must save their home!

programme.title: Fight To The Finish
programme.desc: Someone stole Hiro's invention and is using it for evil! Hiro must join forces with his friends and a robot named Baymax to save San Fransokyo before it's too late!

programme.title: Cars
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen takes to the track in three tales of speed! Follow along with word-for-word narration in this level one World of Reading reader bind up featuring Cars, Racing Days, etc.

programme.title: Driving Buddies
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, gets lost and finds friends in a small town. He learns important life lessons. Get ready for an exciting adventure!

programme.title: Driving School
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Mater must teach hot rod racers the rules of Radiator Springs. This story features characters from Disney/Pixar's Cars, promising a fun-filled adventure for young readers.

programme.title: Racing Days
programme.desc: Doc and Chick Hicks hold 3 races to see whose racing school is best. While Doc's student racers follow the rules, Chick's student racers bend them.

programme.title: Racing For Good
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Jeff Gorvette love to race, but there is one thing they love more: helping others. In this action-packed storybook, Lightning and his friends race to raise money to help old cars.

programme.title: Rally To The Finish
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater travel to the Black Forest for a race. Lightning is excited to race through the forest, but Mater gets scared when an old car tells them that a monster lives there.

programme.title: Roadwork
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, wants to win the Piston Cup. He ends up in Radiator Springs. McQueen learns that friendship is important.

programme.title: Francesco's Rematch
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his racing rival Francesco Bernoulli challenge each other to a race in Monza, Italy-Francesco's hometown. Both Lightning and Francesco are confident they will win the race.

programme.title: Mater And The Ghost Light
programme.desc: Mater the tow truck loves pranking his friends. But after he hears a scary story, Mater loses all zest for pranking. Now, he just wants to hide!

programme.title: Mater The Greater
programme.desc: Mater the Greater is a brave stunt performer who does many dangerous things in front of crowds. He jumps cars, flies through fire, and rides planes. Now, can he do his biggest stunt?

programme.title: Mater's Junkyard Jamboree
programme.desc: Mater can't wait to show his friends in Radiator Springs the junkyard jukebox he built, but they are too busy rounding up tractors on the loose-and the tractors are causing trouble everywhere they go!

programme.title: Monster Truck Mater

programme.desc: In an attempt to connect the existing world to the ancient times, the team visits the doorways of India, the Buland Darwaza in Fatehpur Sikri in Agra, and Charminar in Hyderabad.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children’s turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn’t happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show’S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India’S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi’S & Bahu’S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What’S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga’S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga’S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga’S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law’s. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law’s family.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we’ll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: Savage Bachelors
programme.desc: Single guys living their best, unapologetic life — from messy habits to weird rules about being single. The video humorously showcases their “rules of bachelorhood” and savage moments.

programme.title: When Mom Visits
programme.desc: The video humorously shows the chaos, excitement, and little annoyances that happen when mom comes to visit. It highlights the mix of over-preparation, care, and funny moments that make her presence unforgettable.

programme.title: Honest Arranged Marriage
programme.desc: The video shows how an arranged marriage scenario would look if everyone were completely honest. It highlights awkward truths, funny realities, and relatable family pressure.

programme.title: When You're Single But Your Best Friend Isn't
programme.desc: The video humorously shows the struggles of being single when your best friend is dating. It highlights the awkward, funny moments and feelings of being left out.

programme.title: When You Are The Youngest In The Group
programme.desc: You’re the baby everyone teases, lectures, and secretly protects—a mix of irritation and affection rolled into one.

programme.title: Why Girl Best Friends Are So Special
programme.desc: The video shows the funny and heartfelt moments that make having a girl best friend so special. From sharing secrets to standing by each other in every situation, it celebrates the bond of true friendship.

programme.title: Absent Minded Things We All Do (part 2)
programme.desc: Highlights common, everyday absent-minded habits that many people can relate to—such as forgetting why you walked into a room or misplacing items. It’s the second part in a series dedicated to showcasing these quirky, relatable moments.

programme.title: Signs Romance Has No Age Limit
programme.desc: The video shows how love and romance remain special at any age. It highlights the sweet, funny, and heartwarming moments that prove romance knows no boundaries of time.

programme.title: If Teachers Could Hear Your Thoughts
programme.desc: A humorous take on what would happen if teachers could actually hear the unfiltered thoughts of their students — revealing all the sarcasm, boredom, and chaos that usually stay inside their heads.

programme.title: If You Could Hear Your Colleague's Thoughts
programme.desc: What your co-workers really think: the yawns, the “why did they email me this?”, the lunchtime strategies. The video explores the humorous disconnect between office faces and internal thoughts.

programme.title: Savage Mom Vs Savage Daughter
programme.desc: Two strong personalities — mother and daughter — going head to head in witty comebacks, power games, and hidden affection. It shows how love and defiance intertwine in that bond.

programme.title: 5 Tough Decisions Teenagers Have To Make
programme.desc: This FilterCopy video explores the tricky and relatable choices teenagers face growing up. Alam Khan and Devishi Madaan bring to life five common but tough decisions that test a teen’s judgment, emotions, and priorities.

programme.title: What Moms Say Vs What They Mean
programme.desc: Everyday conversations with Mom are shown with the “surface” meaning and the hidden real meaning—because what she says (“Do what you want”) is often not what she means (“Don’t you dare!”)

Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life’s challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Jai Balaji Mehndipur Wale
programme.desc: The film is based on the famous Jai Balaji Mehandipur Wale temple in Rajasthan

programme.title: Lajja
programme.desc: The Film follows four women from different backgrounds in India as they unite to fight against misogyny and violence in their society. Forced marriage, domestic abuse, and honor killings are just some of the struggles they face. Through their determination, they discover the strength of the human spirit, inspiring others to join their fight for justice. With a powerful cast and storyline, sheds light on important social issues and the fight for women's rights. Will these women succeed in creating a better future for themselves and future generations?

programme.title: Munna Baba(dub) (unakaga Ellam Unakka Tamil)
programme.desc: Sakthi, a rich spoilt brat falls for Indhu. His father, Vinu meets his friend Jayaganesh and they agree on a marriage proposal for their children. Sakthi wants to break the deal because he loves Indhu and wants to marry her, but he does not realise that Indhu is Jayaganesh's daughter. He tries to break the engagement by asking his cousins to misbehave and indulge in a fight. Ultimately in the end, the two get married.

programme.title: Chalo Dilli
programme.desc: Mihika, an investment banker, misses her flight to Delhi and meets Manu Gupta, a talkative man. In order to reach Delhi on time, she must tag along with Manu and put up with his antics.

programme.title: Yamla Pagla Deewana
programme.desc: Dharam (Dharmendra) and Gajodhar (Bobby Deol) are a father-son con team skilled in tricking their unsuspecting fellow Indians. When a nonresident Indian, Paramvir (Sunny Deol), arrives from Vancouver claiming to be Dharam's long-lost son, the duo doesn't buy it, but they admire his strength and take him into their fold. Eventually Gajodhar falls for a young woman, Saheba (Kulraj Randhawa). But when Saheba's brothers disapprove of the match, Paramvir designs a plan for Gajodhar to win her back.

programme.title: Maqbool
programme.desc: In Mumbai's criminal underworld, the lord of all lords is Jahangir Khan (Pankaj Kapoor). Those loyal to him include Maqbool (Irfan Khan), his chief. But Maqbool is in love with Nimmi (Tabu), Jahangir's mistress, who convinces him to be ambitious and take over the empire. After maneuvering potential rivals out of the way, Maqbool betrays Jahangir, murdering him in his own bed. However, it isn't long before both Maqbool and Nimmi are haunted by the ghosts of their treacherous deeds.

programme.title: No Problem
programme.desc: Raj is determined to lead an honest life and quit committing petty crimes. However, his friend and accomplice, Yash, always lands them in trouble and leads him further away from a crime-free life.

programme.title: Bhagwan Parsuram
programme.desc: Lord Parshuram, a reincarnation of Lord Vishnu, beheads his mother to prove that duty comes before anything else. Later, he takes upon himself the task of restoring peace on earth.

programme.title: Hitler
programme.desc: Siddhanth Sharma, a strict disciplinarian, is forced to chase hi brother, Amar, after he is accused of murder. However, his wife, Sheila, a lawyer, decides to defend Amar.

programme.title: Insaf Apne Lahoo Se
programme.desc: Mahendra Pratap marries Geeta, but asks Devilal, her first son, to leave the house. Later, Geeta gets arrested for murder due to her husband's false testimony and gives birth to another son in prison.

programme.title: Mera Desh Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Mera Desh Mera Dharam " is a story of the brave sons of a Land now called Bangla Desh. The People of the land responsed to the call of their beloved leader Sheikh Mujibur Rebman and lay down their lives to get free from the clutches of a Military Dictator. The episode of the story reveals the difference between Dictatorship and the Democracy and a litrary hint to all the people of the World particularly to the Indian Sub-continent that is not to bank upen your religion for self defence but the country as a whole. There was a time when people used to defend themselves under the name and banner of a Dharam but today Dharam should be ones own personal affairs to guide him to be a good character and re-union with God after that. But the States affairs should be left to presnt Society which naturally combined of multi-religions and multi-races. The charactors those who playned their parts can only be judged by previewing the movie. How cruel a man can be to remain in power, how sentiment I and sacrifying a man can be to get freedom. you can see in t he movie.

programme.title: Himalay Ki Godmein
programme.desc: A newly qualified young doctor chooses to practise medicine in a small and remote Himalayan village which previously had no doctor or any medical facilities. His fiancée accompanies him but is appalled by the conditions and so leaves, forcing him to make a decision between staying to support the local people, or relocating to be with his love.

programme.title: Azaad Desh Ke Ghulam
programme.desc: When law student Bharti discovers that her father's wealth comes from illegal and immoral activities, she makes a deadly decision to escape that life and draws the attention of a plotting maternal uncle.

programme.desc: A tale of two budding lovers, their glasses, and the unforeseen challenges that come between their first kiss.

programme.title: Budhwaar
programme.desc: In this captivating story, a man residing in a village embarks on a journey to purchase a piece of land within his community, seeking assistance from the sarpanch. Despite his wife and the sarpanch's warnings against buying the land on Budhwaar (Wednesday) due to its inauspicious nature, the man disregards their concerns and proceeds with the purchase. Filled with joy, he begins digging the land with aspirations of cultivating vegetables. However, his enthusiasm is short-lived as he soon discovers the land's infertility. His dreams are shattered as the realization dawns upon him that he has fallen victim to a deceitful scheme. What he decides to do next is a must-see, making this story all the more intriguing.

programme.title: Bandage
programme.desc: A young-adult, aspiring boxer, Aditya, trains with his father to become the best. However, he starts questioning his ambition and skills to make it to the top. Battling with his own troubles, the father tries to motivate Aditya. Will the father-son duo emerge victoriously, or will they crumble down in the face of their adversities?

programme.title: Cratch
programme.desc: When two individuals coming from two different parts of society with completely distinctive thought processes COLLIDE there would be Chaos, Confusion & a lot of disagreement, but would there ever be an eye-opening conversation? Watch this short to find out Kamrul's unique take on Life and how it affects Manay's perception towards it.

programme.title: Bhool
programme.desc: A young actor in dire straits assumes the identity of a retired Army Officer's son in real life to leverage his housing arrangement. The officer, battling memory loss, eventually uncovers the harsh reality about his long-lost son, prompting the actor to flee for his life.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: We all have a fantastic life but we spoil it with our silly ideas of how to live it. This story is about how in trying to define a relationship, we actually end up confining it. One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: An anxious boy is confused if marijuana helps him with his issues. His quest to answer this dilemma leads him into a night full of corruption and deceit.

programme.title: Charitra Varnan
programme.desc: A cab driver comes across a woman standing and crying along the roadside. He tries to help her and tells her that he would drop her home safely. What happens next will leave you stunned.

programme.title: Divorce Celebration
programme.desc: While staging a sarcastic pre-divorce photoshoot, a couple is forced to confront the memories and emotions that prove their love isn’t as over as they thought.

programme.title: Prem Patra
programme.desc: In 1970s India, Sakshi, a curious college girl, stumbles upon a hidden envelope under a garden bench while searching for a dropped coin. Inside is a nameless, heartfelt love letter. Drawn in by its mystery, Sakshi returns the next day—only to find a new letter, this time from the lover’s other half. What begins as a fleeting curiosity becomes a quiet obsession, as Sakshi discovers an untold romance between two people separated by caste and family expectations. When their letter exchange abruptly ends, Sakshi, desperate to see love triumph, writes a reply pretending to be the man. But the woman senses the lie—his scent is missing—and in heartbreak, tears the letter away. Left in disappointment, Sakshi returns once more—only to find a young man with a plastered leg searching under the same bench. Is he the one from the letters? Or just another coincidence?

programme.title: Happily Married Part 2
programme.desc: Rani & Animesh, a couple who is having an affair with Jimmy plan to meet him on Saturday. The story unfolds as their meeting with Jimmy doesn’t go as planned.

programme.title: Half Cake
programme.desc: HALF CAKE is about a single mother who struggles to earn extra wages to fulfil an innocent ask of a cake from her only son. Beyond the cake, it's a tale of innocence and resilience that will touch your heart.

programme.title: Just Take It Easy
programme.desc: The story is basically on internal happiness. Sanjay a businessman is the CEO of Oberoi Industries. He is not happy in his life. Despite having all the materialistic pleasure not happy internally. The company celebrates its success party on its high growth. Sanjay invites a model Priyanka, his girlfriend to the party. He promises her to make the face of Oberoi Industries.

programme.title: Funkaar
programme.desc: A heart-warming tale of a mother who rediscovers her passion for her craft when her daughter pushes her beyond the confines of her daily routine.

programme.title: Jama Punji
programme.desc: A late night conversation between a mother (Sarla) & her son Anshuman, 13 days after the passing of his father where they discuss the reasons for his detachment with his father and how by the end of the night, certain events lead Anshuman to accept and make amends with his deceased father.

programme.title: Harela
programme.desc: A 60-year-old woman and a young man navigate tradition and modernity during the festival in Uttarakhand. Who will uphold their heritage in an evolving world?

programme.title: Harmless
programme.desc: A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.title: Hack-her
programme.desc: Shraddha, about to leave for America through a Corporate that is currently under attack by a hacker, who is on run by the police and is currently on every news channel. Between all this is Vishesh, who truly loves Shraddha, and now even she is going, just like his parents, leaving him all alone. But not everything we see is true, a hacker on a mission, a girl with ambitions, and a lover, sounds good right? But who is who? Do we know the entire truth? Find out everything in our upcoming short film "Hack-Her"

programme.title: Ketaki
programme.desc: At dusk in Mumbai, 22-year-old Ava hoped for a moment with her neighbor Harry, who hurried past, preoccupied. At home, Harry revealed stolen cash from a bank robbery. When Aaron demanded the money at gunpoint, Harry shot him dead. Hearing the shots, Ava discovered the scene and, confessing her love for Harry, chose to stay. They buried Aaron, symbolizing a new beginning. As they prepared to flee, Ava's past caught up with them, leading to another gunshot as they escaped, with the haunting "Behri Duniya" playing on.

programme.title: Green Screen
programme.desc: One day he find something and with the help of his friend, try to fulfill his dream. But, fate has a different game. The world of the 'Haves' and their desire for the little things in lives that eludes them and the desires invoked by Screen, which teaches us to salivate over things we never knew, otherwise existed. Sometimes small things matter the most.

programme.title: Housewarming
programme.desc: A short film signifying how the energies we invite into our house affect us.

programme.title: Harshit
programme.desc: This film is inspired by Shakespeare's Hamlet, written by Dhruva Harsh. It contains all the Shakespearean elements like, betrayal, love, hatred, revenge, sexual jealousy, poetic justice and dilemma of existence. Harshit is a protagonist synonymous to Hamlet, a Hindu boy living in a Muslim dominated area in Mumbai, India, loves Rahila, his neighbour. Later on fate plays a game in which two innocents, Harshit n Rahila are trapped.

programme.title: Pravaah The Flow
programme.desc: This story is about this Nature photographer Shivoham. Through his travel, he likes to explore and capture wonderful, breath taking creations of nature and places. But how can a journey be complete, without interesting escapades? 5 different locations, 5 different interactions revealing the darkest secrets, depth of life, deep hidden emotions and finally, ending the journey with an experience that leaves him all rejuvenated…as if he had a new birth and gets him all set for the next one.

programme.title: Gutargu
programme.desc: Gutargu is a romantic Hindi short story about a guy a girl who admire each other, and are falling for each other secretly. Their unusual love story takes place on a rooftop. Will their love story have a happy ending?

programme.title: Horror Chapters
programme.desc: Many horror events, interaction with super natural possibilities. Exploring the Paranormal

programme.title: Kamera
programme.desc: He is a 12 years old boy, who works in a garbage dump and lives in the slum along with his mother. Both have different ideologies towards life. He is a staunch believer of being positive and has a dream of spreading smiles. But, his mother is a frustrated woman. While working, he finds a digital camera in the dump. His friend tells him that people smile whenever you point it towards them. He soon realizes the same and gets all thrilled to spread smiles including his mother. Unfortunately, the camera gets lost and all his dreams get shattered. What happens next is the core of the film. The story revolves around the perception of a small kid who wants to follow his dreams.

programme.title: Hearts Awash In Sapphire Light
programme.desc: Hearts Awash in Sapphire Light unfolds the tale of two individuals who encounter each other one evening, initially under less-than-ideal circumstances. At first, they engage in petty arguments over trivial matters. However, as time passes, the undeniable power of their connection becomes evident, serving as a poignant reminder that sometimes, the most extraordinary journeys take place within the depths of our own hearts.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Hum Types
programme.desc: Charu, a girl from high society, faces her own struggles. One night, she meets Makrand, a boy from a low social class. Initially, their class difference creates a barrier, but as they spend time together, Charu realizes they share more similarities than differences. Through moments of vulnerability and connection, they discover their common humanity.

programme.title: Girgit
programme.desc: The film is an adaptation of Anton Chekhov's short story Chameleon. It tells a cheeky tale of injustice and corruption exposing the insincerity of public officials and selfish interests that aggravate or subdue their actions.

programme.title: Kajal
programme.desc: Like all elements, humans have a saturation point. What happens when a woman a constantly bullied by her boss, harassed by strangers and abused by her husband finds an abandoned package one night? A package that holds an answer to all her demons. A package that triggers an inner change in her the moment that she lays eyes on it. Kohl captures a turning point in the life of a woman, in a world claimed by men.

programme.title: Rebel
programme.desc: A young man leaves Belgium to help war victims in Syria, but is forced to join an armed group and is left stranded in AL Raqqa. While at home his little brother becomes easy prey for jihadi recruiters. The only thing their mother has left with is to protect: her Son.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: THE HURT LOCKER is an intense portrayal of elite soldiers who have one of the most dangerous jobs in the world: disarming bombs during the Iraq War.

programme.title: Born To Fly
programme.desc: Two American F-35 Lightning II fighters enter Chinese airspace and cause havoc near the coast. Flying at supersonic speeds, the F-35s create sonic booms that damage an oil refinery and fishing boats. Box office smash hit & multiple award winner Born to Fly comes to life with special operations team headed by elite pilots who face death and challenge the limits of the sky and themselves.

programme.title: The Deep Dark
programme.desc: 1956, northern France. When a group of miners are forced to take a professor underground with them for samples in the depths of a coal mine, they quickly realize that they are not alone and discover a crypt from another time, unknowingly waking up a bloodthirsty creature. One watchword: survival.

programme.title: Ted Bundy: American Boogeyman
programme.desc: This is the true story behind the manhunt that brought America’s most fearsome boogeyman to justice. His name is Ted Bundy. A specter roams the highways of the gritty 1970s America hunting for his next prey. Tracking him are intrepid FBI female agent Kathleen & Robert Ressler organizers of the largest manhunt in history to apprehend America’s most Notorious infamous serial killer.

programme.title: Redline
programme.desc: Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs. The film follows a gorgeous young automobile fanaticize driver who becomes part of illegal drag racing competitions organized by exotic car fanatics.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: Every 23rd spring for 23days, it gets to eat…Stranded on a lonely road, a school bus full of high school players must defend themselves from the Creeper, the winged, flesh-eating terror - ancient beast that resurfaces on the earth every 23 years to feed.

programme.title: Exchange Offer
programme.desc: A complaint registered to the manufacturing company for a dead computer brings back nostalgia and surprises in the life of a retired school principle who is living a mundane life.

programme.title: Dum Dum Deega Deega
programme.desc: The solution to your problem is often hidden in the problem itself; all you need is a different outlook. The story of a beggar child, Ajju, who lives on the streets of Mumbai, but dreams big. He challenges his unfortunate fate, with nothing but a 'different outlook' towards the situation he faces.

programme.title: Make Her Happy
programme.desc: Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?
programme.desc: The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. Mainly, dawning upon Hasmuk Parikh's that it's great to dream big for your children, but one must be mentally prepared that those dreams may or not have them in it.

programme.title: Bhagwaan - The Faith
programme.desc: A final chance meeting with a mysterious old homeless man changes everything they’ve experienced that day. The story delves into how deep their faith truly is and how people worship gods. Some use faith and god as a means of solace while others as a crutch for a troubling life.

programme.title: Family
programme.desc: Anvith's friend Karthik is leaving school and moving to another city as his parents are getting divorced. This news makes Anvith very sad. The reason for their divorce which Karthik reveals to Anvith is a regular heated argument between Karthik's parents. Then Anvith also starts noticing the same argument between his parents. So, Anvith decides to do everything right so that their parents don't fight, but end up ruining everything which leads to a more heated argument.

programme.title: Epicfail
programme.desc: It is difficult to understand the truth about Ramayana in today’s time as it gets lost in translation. This is a film about a young and passionate journalist discovering the truth about Sita.

programme.title: Epicfail
programme.desc: It is difficult to understand the truth about Ramayana in today’s time as it gets lost in translation. This is a film about a young and passionate journalist discovering the truth about Sita.

programme.title: 10.30 Lets Go To School
programme.desc: Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

programme.title: Harmless
programme.desc: A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.title: Laugh
programme.desc: A film about who we were and who we've become , how socialising was and where its reached ,how something as simple as laughing has taken a complicated turn

programme.title: Love, Bites
programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: Agarbatti
programme.desc: Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.
